data.narrative:
SunDrive Solar is a seed-stage solar technology company founded by Vince Allen and David Hu, operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The company has raised A$60M+ in total capital, including an A$25.3M ARENA grant awarded in November 2025. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable valuation approach for SunDrive. Using total capital raised (A$60M+) as a proxy for developmental value and applying a standard seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x to a A$4M base produces an implied valuation of A$10M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable; while 9 same-sector peers exist, insufficient data points met the narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), each returning zero matches. A broad all-sector median would introduce unwarranted noise.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to one reliable method, supports a valuation range of A$8M to A$12M, with a median of A$10M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer multiples at the seed stage in Climate & Energy, the nascent stage of the company's commercial trajectory, and the impact of government grant capital on post-seed dilution dynamics. A broader peer set or near-term financing event would materially improve conviction in this range.
